goal: Wave 3 build: Executor runs the edited call on loop resume and cold delivery and tells the model; Editable approval card in the SPA; Selection comment to selection-scoped AI edit; Thread references: thread_outline, thread_search, thread_read; Save an artifact revision to knowledge; Manifest contract and the deck tool; Template picker and list route; Goal record, goal bar and manual Continue NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

slices.title: Executor runs the edited call on loop resume and cold delivery and tells the model
slices.summary: session-core's consume path returns revision and original_action_fingerprint (S4 proto fields 8 and 9) and accepts either fingerprint when revision > 0. resume.rs restore checks compare the fold's pending fingerprint with the original fingerprint for revised approvals and skip the argument-digest equality for that one call, provided tool, step, connection_id and operation match; with the switch off a revised approval falls back as today. The provider-write result gets the D8 edit sentence and a step note edited=<names>. Cold delivery needs no logic change, only tests that the edited input runs and its payload_sha256 is attested. No proto or migration of its own; execution-core deploys first.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: consume-path revision fields, narrow resume.rs relaxation for revised approvals, edit note in the provider-write result, cold-delivery tests, durable_loop_contract tests. Strict slice: Opus hostile review before merge.
test_commands: cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo clean -p execution-core && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib resume
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --lib cold_delivery
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test durable_loop_contract
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p execution-core --test cross_service_loop_contract
cd "apps/Model Plane/rust" && cargo test -q -p session-core --bin session-core consume -- --ignored --test-threads=1

decisions_defaults.D1: An edited approval is a revised descriptor; the resume restore compares the fold's fingerprint to the original fingerprint only when revision > 0 and the switch is on, with tool, step, connection_id and operation pinned.
decisions_defaults.D8: The model learns field names only: the person edited <names> before approving; the sent version differs from the draft.

slices.title: Thread references: thread_outline, thread_search, thread_read
slices.summary: Appends a new ThreadReferenceService (ReadThreadForReference with OUTLINE and PAGE modes plus new messages, no existing message changed) to sessions.proto, the only appender per C-B6, with no migration. A session-core thread_reference module enforces owner-only chat threads, not current, not waived, no ZDR run, active path, 4,000 chars per message, limit 20. Gateway tools thread_outline, thread_search (SearchMessages with thread_id and RECALL purpose) and thread_read take a thread_ref index into the validated context_refs, return untrusted-provenance results capped at 4,000 chars, and are never offered on ZDR or waived turns.
slices.remaining: Whole slice: ThreadReferenceService proto + session-core module, three gateway read tools offered only with validated thread refs. Defaults refuse Space, waived, ZDR, archived and current threads (OD-7; D2-186 default).
